body.name: Implementation-only outcome-scaled pushforward experiment
body.construction: Implementation-only pushforward with no theorem-level credit: for each \(d>0\), define \(\mathsf S_d(X,S,T,Y(0),Y(1),Y)=(X,S,T,dY(0),dY(1),dY)\), with the analogous restriction to observed records. Set \(P^{(d)}_{m,h}=(\mathsf S_d)_{\#}P_{m,h}\) and \(\mathcal M^{(d)}_{m,h}=\{(\mathsf S_d)_{\#}Q:Q\in\mathcal M_{m,h}\}\). The observed support is \(\{d/2,3d/2\}\), the potential-outcome support is \([0,2d]\), and the endpoint map is \((dL_m(h),dU_m(h))\). The pushforward leaves \(h\), \(H_m\), \(a_m\), \(b\), \(k\), \(\rho\), and \(\gamma\) unchanged.
